nodes.name: Brand.java
nodes.summary: Maps the brands table as a JPA entity with a generated id, unique slug, display name, and related products. Lombok supplies constructors, builder, and accessors.

nodes.name: Brand
nodes.summary: JPA entity for brands and their associated products.

nodes.name: Category.java
nodes.summary: Maps the categories table as a hierarchical JPA entity with slug, image URL, active flag, parent-child links, and related products. It models a self-referencing category tree.
nodes.languageNotes: The entity uses self-referencing JPA associations to represent a category tree.

nodes.name: Category
nodes.summary: JPA entity for hierarchical categories and associated products.

nodes.name: BrandRepository.java
nodes.summary: Declares Spring Data access for Brand entities, including lookup by name and slug. It extends JpaRepository for standard persistence operations.

nodes.name: BrandRepository
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository for Brand persistence and unique-name lookups.

nodes.name: CategoryRepository.java
nodes.summary: Declares Spring Data access for Category entities, including lookup by name, slug, root categories, and parent existence checks. It supports category tree reads and deletion safeguards.

nodes.name: CategoryRepository
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository for Category persistence, tree lookups, and child existence checks.

nodes.name: BrandService.java
nodes.summary: Defines the brand service contract for public reads and administrative mutations. Controllers depend on this interface rather than the persistence implementation.

nodes.name: BrandService
nodes.summary: Service contract for brand read and mutation operations.

nodes.name: CategoryService.java
nodes.summary: Defines the category service contract for public reads, administrative mutations, deletion, and image upload. It includes hierarchy-aware operations such as root category listing.

nodes.name: CategoryService
nodes.summary: Service contract for category read, mutation, deletion, and upload operations.

nodes.name: BrandServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements brand reads and mutations with repository access, response mapping, slug generation, transactions, and cache eviction. It is the main business service behind brand controllers.
nodes.languageNotes: Spring transactions and cache annotations separate read-only cached queries from cache-evicting mutations.

nodes.name: BrandServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Transactional BrandService implementation with repository access, mapping, slugging, and cache annotations.

nodes.name: getAllBrands
nodes.summary: Returns a paged list of brand response projections.

nodes.name: getBrandById
nodes.summary: Looks up a brand by id and returns its response projection.

nodes.name: getBrandByName
nodes.summary: Looks up a brand by exact name and returns its response projection.

nodes.name: getBrandBySlug
nodes.summary: Looks up a brand by slug and returns its response projection.

nodes.name: createBrand
nodes.summary: Creates a brand from request data, generates a slug, persists it, and returns the response projection.

nodes.name: updateBrand
nodes.summary: Updates brand fields and regenerates the slug before returning the response projection.

nodes.name: deleteBrandById
nodes.summary: Deletes a brand by id through the service or repository layer.

nodes.name: CategoryServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements category reads, hierarchy mutations, image URL handling, deletion safeguards, upload storage, transactions, and cache management. It is the main business service behind category controllers.
nodes.languageNotes: Spring transactions and cache annotations separate read-only cached queries from cache-evicting mutations.

nodes.name: CategoryServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Transactional CategoryService implementation with hierarchy validation, storage cleanup, repository access, mapping, and cache annotations.

nodes.name: getAllCategories
nodes.summary: Returns a paged list of category response projections.

nodes.name: getCategoryById
nodes.summary: Looks up a category by id and returns its response projection.

nodes.name: getCategoryByName
nodes.summary: Looks up a category by exact name and returns its response projection.

nodes.name: getCategoryBySlug
nodes.summary: Looks up a category by slug and returns its response projection.

nodes.name: getRootCategories
nodes.summary: Returns a paged list of categories with no parent.

nodes.name: createCategory
nodes.summary: Creates a category, resolves an optional parent, normalizes image metadata, generates a slug, and returns the response projection.

nodes.name: updateCategory
nodes.summary: Updates category fields, validates parent changes, cleans up replaced local images, and returns the response projection.

nodes.name: deleteCategoryById
nodes.summary: Deletes a category after guarding against child categories and linked products, then removes the local image when applicable.

nodes.name: uploadCategoryImage
nodes.summary: Stores an uploaded category image and returns the resulting URL.

nodes.name: validateParentDoesNotCreateCycle
nodes.summary: Rejects parent assignments that would make a category its own ancestor or descendant.

nodes.name: SlugUtils.java
nodes.summary: Provides a static slug generator that lowercases text, normalizes Vietnamese diacritics, and collapses punctuation into URL-safe separators. Brand and category services use it to derive slugs from names.
nodes.languageNotes: Normalizer.Form.NFD decomposes accented characters before regex cleanup for stable slug generation.

nodes.name: SlugUtils
nodes.summary: Utility holder for URL slug normalization.

nodes.name: toSlug
nodes.summary: Converts display text into a lowercase, diacritic-stripped, URL-safe slug.
